subject.title: Normal tool text outputs can degrade to “(see attached image)” placeholders in agent context

question: Should saturated prompt recovery prioritize current fresh non-trailing tool output over older projected tool-result history as the remaining fix direction for this issue?
rationale: The focused patch appears to address a source-visible remaining path, but it intentionally changes which session context survives under aggregate pressure, so maintainer intent should settle that tradeoff before the canonical issue closes.

options.title: Accept Fresh-Output Priority
options.body: Review and land the focused prompt-projection fix if preserving the latest tool result is the desired long-session behavior.

options.title: Require Installed-Session Proof
options.body: Keep the issue and candidate PR paused until a redacted installed WebChat, Discord, or Telegram saturated-session run demonstrates the same non-trailing shape outside the helper harness.

options.title: Split Remaining Causes
options.body: Keep this canonical issue open only long enough to split non-trailing aggregate recovery, media downgrade, and channel-specific empty-output reports into narrower maintainable trackers.

recommendation.title: Accept Fresh-Output Priority
recommendation.body: Review and land the focused prompt-projection fix if preserving the latest tool result is the desired long-session behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They authored the nearest merged same-helper protection and are the strongest code-history owner for the recovery-priority choice.
